rows.details: Indian Institute of Information Technology Bhagalpur
Assistant Professor Grade-II, Pay Level-11 (On Contract)

content_sections.heading: Department-wise Vacancies
content_sections.text: Online applications are invited from internal faculty members currently serving as Assistant Professor Grade-II, Pay Level-10 (On Contract) for upgradation in Assistant Professor Grade-II, Pay Level-11 (On Contract) in the various Departments and Disciplines of the Institute.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms
content_sections.text: Upgradation is available from Assistant Professor Grade-II, Pay Level-10 (On Contract) to Assistant Professor Grade-II, Pay Level-11 (On Contract). Contribution to Institute Administration shall be recommended by the concerned Head and approved by the Director for evaluating credit points.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for IIIT Bhagalpur Assistant Professor Grade-II
content_sections.text: Visit the official Institute website at https://www.iiitbh.ac.in and access the Samarth link at https://iiitbhrec.samarth.edu.in/. Complete the online application form on or before 31 October 2026 till 23:55 hrs. Print the completed online application and attach self-attested copies of relevant testimonials, certificates, and enclosures. Super-scribe the envelope with Application No: [Application Number], “Application for the post of Assistant Professor, Pay Level 11 under the [Category] category, in the Department of [Department Name] vide Advt. No.: IIITBH/RECT/ADVT/2026/18.” Send the hardcopy by post or submit it on or before 02 November 2026 till 17:00 hrs to: The Assistant Registrar (Estt), Indian Institute of Information Technology Bhagalpur, Sabour, Bhagalpur-813210, Bihar, India.

content_sections.heading: Documents Required
content_sections.text: Hardcopy of filled online application form Self-attested copies of relevant testimonials and certificates Self-attested copies of experience certificates, offer letters, salary slips, or pay-fixation orders Documentary evidence for claimed credit points Original photo ID proof (Passport, Voter-ID, PAN Card, Aadhar Card, or Government-issued ID) and photocopy for verification

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to submit the online application?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the online application is 31 October 2026 till 23:55 hrs.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date for receiving the hardcopy of the application?
faq.answer: The last date for the receipt of the printout of the application form along with self-attested supporting documents is 02 November 2026 till 17:00 hrs.

faq.question: Q3. Who is eligible to apply for this upgradation?
faq.answer: Internal faculty members currently serving as Assistant Professor Grade-II, Pay Level-10 (On Contract) in the various departments and disciplines of the Institute are eligible to apply.

faq.question: Q4. What is the postal address for submitting the hardcopy application?
faq.answer: The hardcopy must be sent to The Assistant Registrar (Estt), Indian Institute of Information Technology Bhagalpur, Sabour, Bhagalpur-813210, Bihar, India.

faq.question: Q5. Where should queries regarding the recruitment process be sent?
faq.answer: All queries, requests, or communications related to the recruitment process must be directed exclusively to [email protected].
